scope: One previously untested public MIT portfolio template; byte-identical original HTML subset, with eight newly authored custom acceptance requirements. Source-only evaluation, not full-site execution, customer accuracy or real payment.
referenceMethod: Pre-call source inspection by Codex. Five actual manual requirements plus three actual coverage groups per project derived by production intake. Each reference states source support, explicit mismatch or missing runtime/visual evidence. References never enter the provider packet.

criteria.title: Manual requirement 1
criteria.source: Each page's HTML title content must identify Personal rather than Modern Business.

reference.rationale: index.html and resume.html identify Personal but projects.html and contact.html retain Modern Business in title. This is an explicit cross-page HTML-title content mismatch, not a visual branding judgment.

criteria.title: Manual requirement 2
criteria.source: Resume page content must list Web Developer at Stark Industries for 2019 - Present.

reference.rationale: resume.html has this exact role, organization and year range in its experience card. These are public fictional template details, not verified employment.

criteria.title: Manual requirement 3
criteria.source: Resume page content must include a Master's in Web Development and an Undergraduate entry in Computer Science.

reference.rationale: resume.html education cards contain Master's/Web Development and Undergraduate/Computer Science. Only source text is asserted.

criteria.title: Manual requirement 4
criteria.source: Projects page content must not retain the placeholder titles Project Name 1 and Project Name 2.

reference.rationale: Both placeholder titles remain in projects.html h2 elements, contradicting the newly authored negative content constraint.

criteria.title: Manual requirement 5
criteria.source: Contact page source content must contain the literal labels Full name and Email address.

reference.rationale: contact.html contains label elements for name and email with exactly these text labels. The criterion does not establish actual email delivery or rendered accessibility.

criteria.title: Original requirement 1
criteria.source: Contact page copy must state that a reply is normally provided within two working days.

reference.rationale: No reply-time statement occurs anywhere in the complete contact.html source. This is an explicit text-content obligation rather than a demand to prove actual response speed.

criteria.title: Original requirement 2
criteria.source: Download Resume must retrieve a valid PDF containing the current experience and education.

reference.rationale: Only HTML source subset supplied; the source link is not a downloaded PDF and no browser download or PDF contents are available.

criteria.title: Original requirement 3
criteria.source: The portrait must depict the portfolio owner and remain uncropped at 375px on a phone.

reference.rationale: Image bytes, CSS, identity confirmation and mobile browser observations are not supplied; source alone cannot establish image subject or crop.
